http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 鼠疫，一种历史上曾导致数千万人死亡的细菌感染，至今仍在非洲和美洲部分地区出现。根据世界卫生组织，自1990年代以来，非洲特别是刚果和马达加斯加报告了大多数人类病例。美国每年平均有约7例病例，主要发生在西部农村地区。最近，俄罗斯西伯利亚一家鼠疫研究机构的一名工作人员死于肺炎，引发了对鼠疫的担忧。尽管如此，俄罗斯当局表示，检测未发现鼠疫证据，该研究机构已实施隔离。鼠疫由耶尔森菌引起，主要通过跳蚤从感染动物传播给人类。如果不及时治疗，肺鼠疫和败血性鼠疫都可能致命。

The plague is caused by Yersinia pestis, which spreads among rodents and can be transmitted to humans through fleas. Both bubonic and pneumonic plague are fatal if not treated early.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 2026年10月，西伯利亚一鼠疫研究所一名实验室工作人员因肺炎死亡。当地报告称她可能打破了含有鼠疫细菌的试管，但俄罗斯当局否认这一说法，并向世界卫生组织(WHO)表示，在她及其密切接触者的检测中未发现鼠疫。同时，俄罗斯当局据报道隔离了多达200人，公共卫生专家称这是对孤立性肺炎病例的不寻常反应。10月4日，WHO在媒体报道第二例不明原因肺炎病例后要求俄罗斯提供更多信息。布朗大学公共卫生学院流行病中心主任Jennifer Nuzzo表示，事件模式与实验室事故导致工作人员生病的解释不符，因为实验室有应对意外暴露的协议，且抗生素可有效治疗自然发生的鼠疫细菌。一些专家认为可能涉及工程病原体而非自然病原体。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: In October 2026, a laboratory worker at a plague research institute in Siberia died from pneumonia. Local reports suggested she broke a test tube containing plague bacteria, but Russian authorities disputed this account, informing WHO that plague was not detected in her tests or those of her close contacts. Meanwhile, Russian authorities reportedly quarantined up to 200 people, an unusual response for an isolated pneumonia case. WHO requested more information after media reports of a second pneumonia case of unknown cause. Jennifer Nuzzo, director of the Pandemic Center at Brown University's School of Public Health, noted that the pattern of events doesn't fit with a lab accident explanation, as protocols exist for such exposures and antibiotics are effective treatment. Some experts have raised the possibility of an engineered pathogen rather than a naturally occurring one.

https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/08/us-h.summary_zh: 丙型肝炎是一种严重的血液传染病，主要影响肝脏，可能导致肝硬化等致命疾病。英国、埃及和挪威等国近年来在消除丙肝方面取得显著进展，通过增加常规检测和提供免费或可负担的药物。英国实施了"选择退出"检测政策，部署移动检测小组，并提供免费的家庭检测套件。与此相比，美国在消除丙肝方面进展相对缓慢。1990年代丙肝治疗有限，而现在有治愈率超过95%的药物，疗程仅8-12周。
https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/08/us-h.summary_en: Hepatitis C is a serious bloodborne infectious disease affecting the liver, potentially leading to chronic conditions like cirrhosis. While countries like England, Egypt, and Norway have made significant progress in eliminating hepatitis C through increased testing and affordable medication, the U.S. lags behind. England implemented "opt-out" testing policies in emergency departments, mobile testing teams, and free at-home testing kits. Effective treatments developed in the 2000s can cure over 95% of chronic cases in just 8-12 weeks with minimal side effects. Despite medical advances, the U.S. has yet to establish a comprehensive national strategy comparable to successful European approaches.

2023年9月：帕梅拉·安德森因在丙肝防治方面的勇气获得amfAR勇气奖

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Plague, a rare bacterial infection infamous for killing tens of millions in 14th-century Europe, persists today. According to WHO, most human cases have been reported in Africa, particularly Congo and Madagascar, since the 1990s. The CDC notes an average of about seven human cases annually in the U.S., mainly in rural western areas. Recently, a worker at a plague research institute in Siberia died of pneumonia, raising concerns in Russia, though tests showed no evidence of plague. The plague exists in three forms: bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic, all caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria. It spreads through infected fleas, contact with infected animals, or respiratory droplets from pneumonic plague patients. Early antibiotic treatment can cure the disease, with vaccines recommended only for high-risk individuals.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 美国疾控中心前主任罗伯特·雷德菲尔德对俄罗斯西伯利亚伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所一名28岁女研究员达里娅·希皮洛娃的死亡事件提出质疑。俄罗斯卫生监督机构称她死于"未知原因的肺炎"，但未经证实的报道称她可能意外打破了含有活体鼠疫细菌的试管。目前约200名与希皮洛娃有过接触的人已被置于观察下，该地区医院和产科单位已被隔离。雷德菲尔德质疑俄罗斯实验室是否对鼠疫细菌进行了基因改造，使其更具传染性，并指出如果该菌株对抗生素不敏感，可能解释为何常规治疗无效。美国、欧盟和世界卫生组织已要求俄罗斯对此事件保持透明，特朗普总统表示将与普京讨论此事。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Former CDC Director Robert Redfield questioned whether a Russian laboratory had modified plague bacteria following the death of 28-year-old researcher Darya Shipilova at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia. Russian health authorities claimed she died from 'pneumonia of unknown aetiology,' but unconfirmed reports suggest she may have accidentally broken a test tube containing live plague bacteria. Approximately 200 people who came into contact with Shipilova are under observation, and hospitals and a maternity unit in the region have been quarantined. Redfield raised concerns about whether the plague strain was manipulated for increased transmissibility, possibly as part of a bioweapons program, and suggested the strain might be resistant to antibiotics. The US, EU, and WHO have called for transparency from Russia, with President Trump stating he would discuss the matter

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 鼠疫是一种罕见的细菌感染，曾在14世纪欧洲造成数千万人死亡，但至今仍未被消灭。根据世界卫生组织数据，自1990年代以来，大多数人类病例报告来自非洲，特别是刚果和马达加斯加。美国疾病控制与预防中心数据显示，美国每年平均约有7例人类病例，主要分布在美国西部的农村地区。最近，西伯利亚一家鼠疫研究所的一名工作人员因肺炎死亡，引发俄罗斯当局警惕，但检测结果显示无鼠疫证据。该研究所已被隔离。英国雷丁大学西蒙·克拉克教授表示，鼠疫仍然存在于我们周围，除非消灭野生动物，否则无法根除细菌。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Plague, a rare bacterial infection that killed millions in 14th-century Europe, still exists today. According to WHO, most human cases since the 1990s have been reported in Africa, particularly Congo and Madagascar. CDC data shows an average of about seven human cases annually in the US, mainly in rural western areas. Recently, a worker at a plague research institute in Siberia died of pneumonia, raising concerns in Russia, though tests showed no plague evidence and the institute was quarantined. Plague exists in three forms: bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic, all caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria. It spreads through infected fleas bites or contact with infected animals. Early treatment with antibiotics can cure plague, but it can be fatal if untreated.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.treatment: 早期使用抗生素可治愈鼠疫，关键是及时就医。世界卫生组织建议仅对高风险人群（如实验室和医疗工作者）接种鼠疫疫苗，但尚无证据表明疫苗对肺鼠疫有效。美国目前没有鼠疫疫苗。预防措施包括避免接触受感染的跳蚤和动物，处理死病动物时需格外小心。肺鼠疫患者可通过呼吸道飞沫传播，但传播距离有限，需要面对面接触才能传播。

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 鼠疫是一种罕见的细菌感染，曾在14世纪欧洲造成数千万人死亡，但至今仍未消失。据世界卫生组织数据，自1990年代以来，大多数人类病例报告于非洲，特别是刚果和马达加斯加。美国疾病控制与预防中心数据显示，美国平均每年约有7例人类病例，主要分布在美国西部的农村地区。近期，西伯利亚一家鼠疫研究所的一名工作人员因肺炎死亡，引发俄罗斯当局警惕，但检测结果显示无鼠疫证据。鼠疫分为腺鼠疫、肺鼠疫和败血性鼠疫三种形式，均由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起，可通过受感染的跳蚤叮咬、接触感染动物体液或吸入肺鼠疫患者的呼吸道飞沫传播。早期使用抗生素可有效治疗。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: The plague, a rare bacterial infection that killed millions in 14th-century Europe, still exists today. According to WHO, most human cases have been reported in Africa, particularly Congo and Madagascar, since the 1990s. The CDC indicates an average of about seven human cases annually in the US, mainly in rural western areas. Recently, a worker at a plague research institute in Siberia died of pneumonia, causing concern in Russia, though tests showed no evidence of plague. The plague, caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria, exists in three forms: bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic. It spreads through infected fleas, contact with infected animals, or respiratory droplets from pneumonic plague patients. When treated early with antibiotics, the plague can be cured.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.treatment: 鼠疫可通过早期使用抗生素治疗，关键在于及时就医。预防措施包括避免接触受感染的动物、处理死病动物时采取额外防护、避免与肺鼠疫患者进行面对面接触。世界卫生组织仅推荐高风险人群（如实验室和医护人员）接种鼠疫疫苗，但尚无证据表明疫苗对肺鼠疫有效。美国目前没有可用的鼠疫疫苗。

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 鼠疫是一种罕见的细菌感染，曾在14世纪欧洲造成数千万人死亡，但从未被根除。据世界卫生组织，自1990年代以来，大多数人类病例报告在非洲，特别是刚果和马达加斯加。美国疾病控制与预防中心数据显示，美国平均每年约报告7例病例，主要发生在美国西部农村地区。最近，俄罗斯西伯利亚一名鼠疫研究所工作人员死于肺炎，引发关注，但官方测试显示无鼠疫证据。鼠疫可通过受感染的跳蚤叮咬、接触受感染的体液或吸入肺鼠疫患者的呼吸道飞沫传播。早期使用抗生素可有效治疗。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Plague, a rare bacterial infection infamous for killing tens of millions in 14th-century Europe, has never been eradicated. Since the 1990s, most human cases have been reported in Africa, particularly Congo and Madagascar, according to WHO. The CDC reports an average of about seven human cases annually in the U.S., mostly in rural western areas. Recently, a worker at a plague research institute in Siberia died of pneumonia, raising concerns in Russia, though authorities confirmed no evidence of plague. The disease, caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria, spreads through infected fleas, contact with infected bodily fluids, or respiratory droplets from pneumonic plague patients. Early antibiotic treatment is effective, but without treatment, plague can be fatal.

https://www.gov.uk/government/news/flu-l.summary_zh: 英国卫生安全局(UKHSA)发布冬季呼吸道病毒监测报告显示，9月流感活动高于过去四年同期。尽管流感活动仍处于基线(非常低)水平，但自8月以来呈上升趋势，可能预示着早期流感季的到来。报告指出，欧洲和英国近期发现的A(H1N1)流感病毒已发生"漂移"，与今年流感疫苗中的病毒成分有所不同。UKHSA流行病学家表示，流感水平正在上升，尽管流感疫苗对漂移毒株仍能有效预防严重流感。去年尽管病毒漂移且流感季提前开始，但整体病例数和估计死亡率低于前一年，疫苗接种计划预防了约10万例住院和7000例死亡。
https://www.gov.uk/government/news/flu-l.summary_en: UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) has published its first weekly winter respiratory virus surveillance report, showing flu activity in September was higher than in the same period over the past 4 winter seasons. Although still at baseline levels, flu trends have been rising since August with possible signs of an early flu season. The report indicates that an A(H1N1) flu virus recently seen in Europe and the UK has 'drifted' compared to the vaccine component. UKHSA's consultant epidemiologist notes flu levels are increasing, but flu vaccines typically remain effective at preventing severe flu even with drifted strains. Despite last year's earlier start and drifted virus, overall cases were lower than the previous year, with vaccination preventing approximately 100,000 hospital admissions and 7,000 deaths in England.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Former CDC Director Robert Redfield questioned whether Russia may have manipulated the plague bacteria after a 28-year-old lab technician, Darya Shipilova, died at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia. Approximately 200 people who came into contact with Shipilova are under observation, and hospitals and a maternity unit in the region have been quarantined. Redfield noted Russia's aggressive response, pointing out pneumonic plague is not highly infectious with the last US human transmission occurring in 1924. He raised concerns about potentially manipulated strains or other pathogens. The US, EU, and WHO have called for transparency from Russia regarding the case.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 鼠疫是一种罕见的细菌感染，曾在14世纪欧洲导致数千万人死亡，但至今仍未消失。据世界卫生组织数据，自1990年代以来，大多数人类病例报告来自非洲，特别是刚果和马达加斯加。美国疾病控制与预防中心数据显示，美国平均每年约有7例人类病例，主要分布在美国西部的农村地区。近期，西伯利亚一家鼠疫研究所的一名工作人员因肺炎死亡，引发俄罗斯当局担忧，但检测结果显示无鼠疫证据。鼠疫分为腺鼠疫、肺鼠疫和败血性鼠疫三种形式，由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起，可通过受感染的跳蚤叮咬或接触受感染动物传播。早期使用抗生素治疗可有效治愈鼠疫。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: The plague, a rare bacterial infection that killed millions in 14th-century Europe, still exists today. According to WHO, most human cases since the 1990s have been reported in Africa, particularly Congo and Madagascar. The CDC notes an average of about seven human cases annually in the US, mainly in rural western areas. Recently, a worker at a plague research institute in Siberia died of pneumonia, prompting quarantine of the facility, though tests showed no evidence of plague. The plague, caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria, exists in three forms: bubonic, pneumonic, and septicemic. It spreads through infected fleas bites or contact with infected animals. Early antibiotic treatment can cure the plague, which is fatal if untreated.

https://www.newsweek.com/former-cdc-dire.summary_zh: 俄罗斯西伯利亚伊尔库茨克反鼠疫研究所一名28岁女性研究员达里娅·希皮洛娃(Darya Shipilova)死亡，引发国际关注。俄罗斯消费者权益保护和公益监督局(Rospotrebnadzor)称其死于"未知原因肺炎"，但未证实的报道称她可能意外打破含有活细菌的试管，感染肺鼠疫。约200名与希皮洛娃有接触的人员已被隔离观察，当地医院和产科单位也被隔离。美国CDC前主任罗伯特·雷德菲尔德质疑俄罗斯实验室可能修改了鼠疫细菌，使其更具传染性或对抗生素不敏感。美国、欧盟和世界卫生组织已要求俄罗斯对此事保持透明。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示将与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京讨论此事。
https://www.newsweek.com/former-cdc-dire.summary_en: A 28-year-old female researcher at Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute in Siberia, Russia, has died, raising international concerns. Russian health authorities reported she died from 'pneumonia of unknown aetiology', but unconfirmed reports suggest she may have accidentally broken a test tube containing live plague bacteria. Approximately 200 people who came into contact with the deceased have been placed under observation, and local hospitals and a maternity unit have been quarantined. Former CDC Director Robert Redfield questioned whether the Russian laboratory had modified the plague bacteria to be more transmissible or antibiotic-resistant. The US, EU, and WHO have called for transparency from Russia, and President Trump stated he would discuss the matter with Russian President Putin.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Russia's Irkutsk region reported a suspected case of pneumonic plague resulting in the death of 28-year-old anti-plague biolab worker Daria Shipilova. The U.S. responded with heightened concern, with the Moscow Embassy issuing a health alert on October 6 acknowledging the case, death, and hospital quarantines. Secretary of State Marco Rubio called on Russia to share more information, and the U.S. has formally requested details from Moscow. President Trump described the situation as a 'big problem' for Russia and scheduled a call with Putin. While the World Health Organization notes pneumonic plague is invariably fatal when untreated, capable of killing within 18-24 hours, its pandemic potential in the modern world is considered relatively low.

•قال: "لا نعتقد ذلك. سنكتشف ذلك قريباً، لكننا لا نعتقد ذلك."

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.brief_zh: 菲律宾麻疹爆发后出现SSPE病例，25%患者于2022年确诊，与2018-2019年疫情相关。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎(SSPE)是麻疹的延迟并发症，几乎总是致命。菲律宾在2010-2011年、2013年和2018-2019年经历了麻疹爆发，其中2018-2019年的爆发是世界卫生组织西太平洋地区最大的。研究回顾了2007-2022年期间在奎松城一家三级儿科医院收治的20名SSPE患儿，估计其麻疹感染年份。患者入院中位年龄为6.2岁，报告麻疹发病时中位年龄为0.7岁。20例入院患者中有5例(25.0%)发生在2022年，估计感染日期显示4例患者在2018-2019年爆发期间感染，均在2020-2022年入院。考虑到SSPE有多年潜伏期，未来几年可能出现更多病例。四分之一患者无法确定麻疹病史。需要加强麻疹监测并维持两剂疫苗接种覆盖率。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis (SSPE) is a delayed, almost uniformly fatal complication of measles. The Philippines experienced measles outbreaks in 2010-2011, 2013, and 2018-2019, with the latter being the largest in the WHO Western Pacific Region. Researchers reviewed 20 children admitted with SSPE to a tertiary pediatric hospital in Quezon City from 2007-2022, estimating their year of measles infection. Median patient age at admission was 6.2 years and 0.7 years at reported measles illness. Five (25.0%) of 20 admissions occurred in 2022, with estimated infection dates placing 4 patients within the 2018-2019 outbreak; all were admitted during 2020-2022. Given SSPE's multiyear latency, additional cases may emerge in coming years. Measles history could not be established in one quarter of patients. Strengthened measles surveillance and sustained 2-dose vaccination coverage are neede

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.title_zh: 格陵兰北极熊检出高致病性禽流感H5病毒
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.brief_zh: 研究发现东格陵兰北极熊体内存在高致病性禽流感H5病毒抗体
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: 研究人员在东格陵兰北极熊体内检测到高致病性禽流感H5病毒抗体。2024年采集的样本中有3/14只(21%)北极熊呈阳性，2025年增加到6/14只(43%)。其中4只2025年采集的北极熊体内检测到针对全球流行的H5 clade 2.3.4.4b高致病性禽流感病毒的抗体，表明这些北极熊曾暴露于该病毒并存活。高致病性禽流感(HPAI)正在成为北极地区新兴的生态和公共卫生威胁，季节性鸟类迁徙创造了HPAI爆发的热点区域。此前已有报告称，美国阿拉斯加和挪威斯瓦尔巴群岛的死亡北极熊感染了HPAI(H5N1和H5N5)。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: Researchers detected influenza A virus antibodies in plasma from East Greenland polar bears, with increasing positivity rates from 21% (3/14) in 2024 to 43% (6/14) in 2025. Four bears from 2025 showed antibodies to the globally emerging highly pathogenic avian influenza H5 clade 2.3.4.4b, suggesting survival after exposure. Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) poses an emerging ecological and public health threat in the Arctic, with seasonal bird migrations creating hotspots for outbreaks. Previous cases of deceased HPAI-infected polar bears have been reported in Alaska (H5N1 in 2023) and Svalbard, Norway (H5N5 in 2026).

https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/13/hele.summary_zh: 知名传染病记者Helen Branswell于周二因癌症并发症去世，享年69岁。Branswell以其对传染病和公共卫生的清晰、细致报道而闻名，报道范围涵盖流感、脊髓灰质炎、埃博拉和COVID-19等多种疾病。她在2003年多伦多SARS爆发期间开始接触传染病报道，随后成为加拿大通讯社的医疗记者，并于2015年加入STAT新闻。Branswell曾获得维克托·科恩医学科学报道卓越奖、乔治·波克公共服务奖，并曾两次与同事一起因早期COVID报道获得普利策奖提名。世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞称赞她'对证据、科学和真理坚定不移的承诺'。
https://www.statnews.com/2026/10/13/hele.summary_en: Renowned infectious disease reporter Helen Branswell died at age 69 due to complications from cancer. Branswell was celebrated for her clear and nuanced reporting on infectious diseases and public health, covering a range of diseases from influenza to polio, Ebola to COVID-19. She began covering infectious diseases during Toronto's 2003 SARS outbreak and later became a medical reporter at Canadian Press before joining STAT in 2015. Branswell received numerous awards including the Victor Cohn Prize for Excellence in Medical Science Reporting and the George Polk Award for Public Service. She was also a Pulitzer Prize finalist for her early COVID coverage. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus praised her 'unwavering commitment to evidence, science, and truth'.

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.brief_zh: 荷兰研究发现新冠感染或疫苗接种可能影响MERS冠状病毒血清学检测准确性
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: 荷兰研究探讨了SARS-CoV-2暴露对MERS-CoV血清学检测特异性的影响。MERS-CoV自2012年发现以来，在人类中引起小规模爆发，病死率约为30%-40%。研究测试了荷兰不同SARS-CoV-2暴露人群(包括轻症和重症新冠患者及疫苗接种者)的血清样本，发现SARS-CoV-2暴露诱导的MERS-CoV抗体主要针对保守的S2结构域，偶尔具有中和能力。研究指出，结合MERS-CoV S1结合和中和能力可以限制SARS-CoV-2诱导的交叉反应对MERS-CoV血清学的影响，这对MERS-CoV感染的准确诊断具有重要意义。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: Dutch researchers investigated the impact of SARS-CoV-2 exposure on the specificity of MERS-CoV serology. Since its discovery in 2012, MERS-CoV has caused small outbreaks in humans with case-fatality rates of approximately 30%-40%. The study tested serum samples from Dutch individuals with different SARS-CoV-2 exposures, including mild and severe COVID-19 patients and vaccinated individuals. Findings revealed that SARS-CoV-2 exposure induced MERS-CoV antibodies primarily targeting the conserved S2 domain, with occasional neutralizing capacity. The research suggests that combining MERS-CoV S1 binding with neutralization can limit the influence of SARS-CoV-2-induced cross-reactivity on MERS-CoV serology, which is crucial for accurate diagnosis of MERS-CoV infections.

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.brief_zh: 台湾儿童肺炎支原体感染率翻倍，重症和神经系统并发症显著增加，出现新型耐药亚型。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: COVID-19大流行后，肺炎支原体在全球范围内重新出现，在台湾尤为严重。与2019年高峰相比，2024年发病率翻倍（546/10万人口），重症监护病房入院率增加2.2倍（10.9/10万人口），神经系统并发症增加13.7倍（6.1/10万人口）。2023-2024年前瞻性队列研究（n=226）发现，中性粒细胞>7,000/μL、血小板>400×10³/μL、胸腔积液和中枢神经系统受累是重症监护入院的风险因素。698个基因组的系统发育分析显示，4个新兴亚型到2024年中期取代了COVID-19前的谱系，其中1个亚型与严重结果相关，突显了不断演变的耐药、亲神经谱系，呼吁加强监测。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: Post-COVID-19 pandemic has seen a global resurgence of Mycoplasma pneumoniae, particularly severe in Taiwan. A multicenter study revealed that compared to the 2019 peak, 2024 data showed a doubling of incidence (546/100,000 population), a 2.2-fold increase in ICU admissions (10.9/100,000 population), and a 13.7-fold surge in central nervous system complications (6.1/100,000 population). In a 2023-2024 prospective cohort (n=226), risk factors for ICU admission included neutrophils >7,000/μL (aOR 6.2), platelets >400 × 10³/μL (aOR 12.5), pleural effusion (aOR 9.7), and central nervous system involvement (aOR 27.9). Phylogenetic analysis of 698 genomes demonstrated that 4 emerging subclades replaced pre-COVID-19 lineages by mid-2024, with one subclade associated with severe outcomes, highlighting evolving resistant, neurotropic lineages and calling for enhanced surveillance.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: The article discusses a possible plague case following the death of a lab worker at Russia's Antiplague Research Institute in Siberia. Russian authorities denied the worker had plague, but independent media reported she may have broken a vial containing Yersinia pestis bacteria. Dr. Heather Young notes that while concerning due to the worker's young age, the risk to the rest of the world is extremely low. The CDC is screening travelers from Siberia entering the US. Colorado has reported four human plague cases and two deaths since 2021. Hospitals in the region are equipped to handle plague cases with standard medical masks and antibiotics. A seven-day antibiotic course can prevent infection in exposed individuals.

Media reports suggested a possible lab accident, but this remains unconfirmed. The plague, caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria, exists in three forms: bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic. Pneumonic plague, suspected in this case, is the most severe with near 100% mortality if untreated.

The report covers various diseases including Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever (CCHF), Ebola virus, Marburg virus, Avian influenza A(H5N1), pneumonic plague, Lassa fever, Mpox, and Nipah virus. Key updates include Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, Marburg virus disease in Ethiopia, evidence of Avian influenza in Brazil, CCHF case in Greece, pneumonic plague case in the US, and changes in Mpox clade I transmission status from limited to community transmission in several African countries. The information is continuously updated through 2025, reflecting the latest epidemiological developments.

https://www.gov.uk/government/news/data-.brief_zh: 英国调查显示流感症状导致47%的工作或学习人群缺勤
https://www.gov.uk/government/news/data-.summary_zh: 英国卫生安全局(UKHSA)发布FluSurvey调查结果，显示流感样症状对人们日常生活的影响。调查涵盖2023-24和2024-25两个完整冬季，完成超过68,000份每周症状调查。结果显示，47%的工作或学习人群因流感症状缺勤，大多数人居家治疗，14%寻求医生或医疗服务帮助。英国已有超过700万儿童和成人接种流感疫苗。专家强调流感疫苗不仅可预防严重疾病，还能减少对工作、经济和教育的影响。流感是英国最长期的参与式监测系统，为社区疾病传播提供宝贵见解。
https://www.gov.uk/government/news/data-.summary_en: UKHSA has published insights from FluSurvey, revealing the impact of flu-like illness on daily life. The survey, covering two full winter seasons (2023-24 and 2024-25) with over 68,000 weekly symptom reports, shows 47% of working or studying individuals missed work or school due to flu symptoms. Most treated symptoms at home while 14% sought medical help. Over 7 million children and adults have received flu vaccination, which remains the best protection against serious illness and reduces disruption to workplaces, economy, and education. Experts emphasize vaccination's importance not only for personal protection but also to prevent spread to vulnerable groups.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 俄罗斯西伯利亚一名28岁的鼠疫研究员达里娅·希皮洛娃在工作期间生病，并于10月2日死亡。事件发生在伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所。目前已有近200人被隔离。关于她的死因存在矛盾信息：俄罗斯高级官员最初称她死于鼠疫，后修改为"可能"死于鼠疫；而俄罗斯卫生监督机构则称她死于"病因不明的肺炎"。有报道称她可能是在实验室事故中被感染，但这一信息尚未得到证实。鼠疫是由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起的疾病，可通过跳蚤从动物传播给人类，分为腺鼠疫、败血性鼠疫和肺鼠疫三种类型。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: A 28-year-old plague researcher at Russia's Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute fell ill at work and died on October 2, leading to quarantine of nearly 200 people in Siberia. The cause of death remains unclear, with conflicting reports: a Russian official initially stated she died from plague, later adding "possibly," while Russia's health watchdog attributed her death to "pneumonia of unknown etiology." Local media suggested a lab accident might have caused the infection, but this remains unconfirmed. The incident has raised concerns about potential pneumonic plague spread, though no outbreak has been confirmed. Plague, caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria, can be treated with antibiotics if administered promptly, though antibiotic-resistant strains have emerged.

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.brief_zh: 巴西塞阿拉州2010-2025年登革热病毒传播动态研究，发现13次主要疫情波
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: 该研究评估了2010-2025年巴西塞阿拉州登革热病毒的传播动态。塞阿拉州是登革热高度流行地区，所有4种登革热病毒血清型共同循环，主要是DENV-1和DENV-2，且DENV-3最近重新引入。研究提供了登革热疫苗上市后评估的流行病学基线。2010年1月3日至2025年1月25日期间，巴西全国报告了1,657,046例实验室确诊登革热病例，覆盖全国98.9%的市镇。全国范围内确定了13次主要疫情波，年发病率从4.0到190.4例/10万居民不等，最大疫情发生在2024年。在塞阿拉州，共报告了131,961例实验室确诊病例，累计发病率为1,500例/10万居民。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: This study evaluated the transmission dynamics of dengue virus (DENV) in Ceará State, Brazil, from 2010-2025. Ceará is a dengue hyperendemic region where all four DENV serotypes co-circulate, predominantly DENV-1 and DENV-2, with DENV-3 recently reintroduced. From January 2010 to January 2025, Brazil reported 1,657,046 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases across 98.9% of municipalities. Thirteen major epidemic waves were identified nationally, with annual incidence ranging from 4.0 to 190.4 cases per 100,000 inhabitants, with the largest epidemic occurring in 2024. In Ceará specifically, 131,961 laboratory-confirmed cases were reported, corresponding to a cumulative incidence of 1,500 cases per 100,000 inhabitants.

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.brief_zh: 研究开发数字PCR技术，可从废水中区分禽流感和季节性流感病毒
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: 高致病性禽流感A(H5Nx)病毒，特别是2.3.4.4b分支，对全球健康构成重大风险。研究人员结合并试点了两种双重反转录数字PCR方法，用于废水中区分禽流感和季节性流感病毒。这种方法能够快速、特异性地检测，减少流感病毒环境监测中的模糊性。高致病性禽流感病毒在野生和家禽中广泛传播，并偶尔溢出到哺乳动物物种和人类中。废水和环境监测为临床、兽医和野生动物监测提供了人群层面的补充。研究人员评估了一种双重反转录数字PCR方法，结合了CDC流感A和B检测组分与JRC-HA和JRC-MP检测，用于区分废水中禽流感和季节性人类流感病毒。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: Highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5Nx) viruses, particularly clade 2.3.4.4b, pose substantial global health risks. Researchers combined and piloted two duplex reverse transcription digital PCRs to discriminate between avian and seasonal influenza viruses in wastewater. This approach enables rapid, strain-specific detection to reduce ambiguity in environmental surveillance for influenza viruses. The viruses continue to circulate widely among wild and domestic birds, with recurrent spillover into mammalian species and sporadic infections in humans. Wastewater and environmental surveillance provides a population-level complement to clinical, veterinary, and wildlife surveillance. The evaluated dual-duplex RT-dPCR approach combines CDC assay components with JRC-HA and JRC-MP assays to differentiate between avian and seasonal human influenza viruses in wastewater.

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: 马达加斯加Fenoarivobe区发生肺鼠疫暴发，2022年1月28日至3月1日期间共报告21例疑似病例，其中12人死亡，病死率达57.1%。疫情最初于2月18日由Bongolava地区卫生局报告，报告了8例疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例。所有病例均有呼吸道症状，常见症状包括咳嗽(81%)、胸痛(71.4%)、血痰(66.7%)和发热(61.9%)。疫情通过家庭内接触或聚会传播，并因鼠疫治疗延迟而加剧。疫情持续33天，攻击率为4.6%(21/45,636居民)。马达加斯加是鼠疫流行地区，通常在8月至4月期间发生传播，大多数病例报告在海拔800米以上的中部高原地区。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: An outbreak of pneumonic plague occurred in Fenoarivobe district, Madagascar, from January 28 to March 1, 2022, with 21 suspected cases (12 fatal) reported. The case-fatality rate was 57.1%. The outbreak was initially reported on February 18 with 8 suspected deaths. All patients exhibited respiratory symptoms, with cough (81%), chest pain (71.4%), bloody sputum (66.7%), and fever (61.9%) being most common. Transmission occurred through household contact and gatherings, amplified by delayed treatment. The outbreak lasted 33 days with an attack rate of 4.6%. Madagascar remains endemic for plague, with transmission typically occurring from August to April, mostly in central highlands above 800m altitude.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 美国亚利桑那州报告一例肺鼠疫死亡病例，这是该州自2007年以来首例肺鼠疫死亡。患者是一名年轻成年男性，在出现症状前4-5天曾接触了两只患病的室内家猫。患者最初被怀疑感染汉坦病毒或细菌性肺炎，接受了哌拉西林-他唑巴坦、万古霉素和阿奇霉素治疗，但病情迅速恶化，入院后不到8小时死亡。检测确认患者血液、血液和肺组织中存在鼠疫耶尔森菌。尽管没有其他人出现症状，但46名潜在接触者（包括家庭成员、同事和医院工作人员）接受了7天环丙沙星暴露后预防治疗。美国每年平均报告5例鼠疫病例，2015年报告16例，2022年报告0例，其中80%以上为腺鼠疫。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Arizona reported a death from pneumonic plague, the state's first since 2007. The patient, a young adult male, had contact with two symptomatic indoor domestic cats 4-5 days before developing symptoms. Initially suspected of having hantavirus or bacterial pneumonia, the patient was treated with piperacillin-tazobactam, vancomycin, and azithromycin but rapidly deteriorated, dying less than 8 hours after hospital admission. Testing confirmed Yersinia pestis in blood cultures, blood, and lung tissue. Although no other people developed symptoms, 46 potentially exposed contacts received a 7-day course of oral ciprofloxacin postexposure prophylaxis. The U.S. averages about 5 human plague cases annually, with 16 reported in 2015 and zero in 2022. Over 80% of cases are bubonic plague.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: Pneumonic plague, a bacterial disease caused by Yersinia pestis, has raised global concerns following the death of a laboratory researcher in Siberia, Russia in late September. The researcher, who died of pneumonia, worked in a plague research laboratory. No additional cases have been reported from the lab since then. Both WHO and CDC are monitoring the situation. According to infectious disease specialist Dr. Thomas Moore, plague has three main forms: bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic. Unlike measles, pneumonic plague bacteria remain infectious for only a short time. Moore notes that plague is endemic in the Western United States, with cases occurring occasionally, though the last reported case was in Colorado last year. He reassures that with early antibiotic treatment, plague can be cured and that people need not worry about the Siberian case spreading globally.

https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: Japan experienced a resurgence of streptococcal toxic shock syndrome (STSS) cases during 2023-2024. The post-COVID-19 resurgence was driven by expansion of M1 UK lineage (49.8%) and emerging M1 13SNPs lineage (37.4%), replacing ancestral M1 global lineage. M1 13SNPs were associated with younger patient age and higher death rates in unadjusted analyses. This nationwide molecular epidemiologic study was coordinated by the National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID) with prefectural public health institutes and sentinel hospitals, with an overall coverage rate of 62.2%.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: According to a recent MMWR report, a man in Arizona died from pneumonic plague after contact with sick cats, marking the state's first pneumonic plague death since 2007. The patient presented with abdominal pain, chest pain, and dry cough, initially thought to have hantavirus or bacterial pneumonia. Despite treatment, the patient died less than 8 hours after admission. Health officials determined the man had occupational exposure to two symptomatic domestic cats 4-5 days before symptoms appeared. Although no other people reported symptoms, 46 potentially exposed contacts received a 7-day course of oral ciprofloxacin postexposure prophylaxis.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: According to a recent MMWR report, a man in Arizona died from pneumonic plague after contact with sick domestic cats. The patient initially presented with abdominal pain, chest pain, and dry cough, leading clinicians to suspect hantavirus or bacterial pneumonia. Despite treatment with antibiotics, his condition worsened and he died less than 8 hours after being admitted to the emergency department. Testing confirmed Yersinia pestis in blood cultures and lung tissue. Investigation revealed occupational exposure to two symptomatic cats 4-5 days before symptom onset. Although no other people reported symptoms, 46 potentially exposed contacts began post-exposure prophylaxis with ciprofloxacin. This marked Arizona's first pneumonic plague death since 2007.

Testing confirmed Yersinia pestis in blood cultures and lung tissue. Investigation revealed occupational exposure to two symptomatic cats 4-5 days before symptom onset. Although the cats couldn't be tested, "inhalation transmission" was considered possible. Health officials identified 46 potentially exposed contacts who received 7-day postexposure prophylaxis with ciprofloxacin. The CDC reports an average of five human plague cases annual

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_zh: 根据MMWR近期发表的报告，美国亚利桑那州一名成年男子因接触患肺鼠疫的病猫而感染并死亡，这是自2007年以来该州首例肺鼠疫死亡病例。该患者出现腹痛、胸痛和干咳等症状，最初被误诊为汉坦病毒或细菌性肺炎，尽管接受了氧疗，但仍于入院后不到8小时死亡。实验室检测在其血液、血液和肺组织中均发现了鼠疫耶尔森氏菌(Y. pestis)。调查显示，患者在症状出现前4-5天曾接触两只患病的室内家猫，这两只猫随后被安乐死。尽管没有其他人报告症状，但包括家庭成员、同事和医院工作人员在内的46名潜在接触者已开始接受为期7天的环丙沙星暴露后预防治疗。
http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: According to a recently published MMWR report, a man in Arizona died from pneumonic plague after contact with sick domestic cats, marking the state's first pneumonic plague death since 2007. Laboratory tests identified Yersinia pestis in blood cultures and lung tissue. Health officials determined the patient had occupational exposure to two symptomatic cats 4-5 days before symptom onset. Both cats were euthanized. Although no other people reported symptoms, 46 potentially exposed contacts, including household members, coworkers, and hospital staff, began a 7-day course of ciprofloxacin postexposure prophylaxis.

https://bbcinsight.pages.dev/news/world-.title_zh: 所谓“马达加斯加鼠疫死亡 40 人”是 2014 年 BBC 旧闻被翻新传播
https://bbcinsight.pages.dev/news/world-.summary_zh:
【说法】bbcinsight.pages.dev（一家打着 BBC 名头的镜像站）上一篇“马达加斯加鼠疫爆发导致 40 人死亡”的文章，页面时间戳显示为 2026 年 10 月 17 日，看起来像是今天的新闻，容易被误读为马达加斯加正在发生新的大规模鼠疫疫情。

【传播手法】整篇搬运 2014 年 11 月 21 日 BBC/路透社原文（原标题 Madagascar plague outbreak kills 40, says WHO，原链接 bbc.com/news/world-africa-30152979），正文细节逐项一致：Soamahatamana 村首例、119 例确诊 40 例死亡、2% 为肺鼠疫、首都 2 例确诊含 1 例死亡、监狱老鼠、杀虫剂抗性。镜像站只换了抓取时间戳（Published: 2026-10-18T00:49:41.244Z），内容一字未改。这是一种典型的“旧闻翻新”：用新时间戳让旧新闻在搜索和推荐流里看起来像突发新闻。

【背景】2014 年那次疫情已于 2015 年 2 月结案，累计 263 例确诊、71 例死亡（Wikipedia）。2026 年 10 月马达加斯加的真实情况是：卫生部 10 月 13 日通报 4 例确诊、5 例疑似，约 200 名接触者接受预防性服药（CIDRAP、Outbreak News Today、Signal Post News 报道一致），属于每年 9 月至次年 4 月流行季的季节性地方疫情，与俄罗斯伊尔库茨克实验室事件无已知关联。旧闻翻新恰好给正在发酵的“第三国扩散”叙事（britbrief.co.uk 系列文章、Opera News 转载）添柴，读者需注意区分 2014 年数字与 2026 年实际情况。

2026-10-13：马卫生部通报新聚集疫情：4 确诊 + 5 疑似，约 200 名接触者预防性服药

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: A man in Arizona died from pneumonic plague after contact with sick domestic cats, marking the state's first pneumonic plague death since 2007, according to a recent MMWR report. The patient developed symptoms after occupational exposure to two cats showing signs of pneumonic plague. Despite treatment with antibiotics including piperacillin-tazobactam, vancomycin and azithromycin, the patient died less than 8 hours after hospital admission. Testing confirmed Yersinia pestis infection in blood cultures and lung tissue. Health officials identified 46 potentially exposed contacts who received post-exposure prophylaxis with ciprofloxacin. While plague cases are rare in the US with an average of five annually, pneumonic plague is exceptionally uncommon, accounting for only 74 cases between 1900 and 2012.

Although no other individuals reported symptoms, 46 potentially exposed contacts, including household members, coworkers, and healthcare staff, began a 7-day course of oral ciprofloxacin for post-exposure prophylaxis.

The researcher worked in a plague research laboratory and died from pneumonia. No additional cases have been reported from the lab. WHO and CDC are monitoring the situation. Dr. Thomas Moore, an infectious disease specialist, explains that plague is caused by Yersinia pestis bacteria and has three main forms: bubonic, septicemic, and pneumonic. Unlike measles, pneumonic plague bacteria linger in the air for only a short time, limiting its transmission. Moore notes that due to the COVID-19 pandemic, people are concerned about outbreak reports, but pneumonic plague is not easily spread, especially from distant locations. Plague is endemic in the Western United States, with cases occurring occasionally but treatable with antibiotics if caught early.

http://www.bing.com/news/apiclick.aspx?r.summary_en: According to a recently published MMWR report, a man in Arizona died from pneumonic plague after contact with sick domestic cats. https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_zh: 世界卫生组织数据显示，结核病在2024年导致约123万人死亡。为加强结核病监测，研究人员开发了Pathotypr，一种基于全基因组测序的对齐免费工具，使用从26,813个基因组中提取的2,145个标记。该工具在88,071个样本测试中提高了分类一致性，扩展了罕见谱系覆盖范围，并检测到耐药标记，支持分子流行病学和公共卫生监测。该工具接受组装基因组或原始短读长序列，返回谱系分配、世卫组织目录化的耐药相关变异和密切相关的参考基因组。该研究由国际结核病耐药预测综合(CRyPTIC)联盟等机构参与。
https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/eid/article/32/11/.summary_en: Tuberculosis caused an estimated 1.23 million deaths in 2024 according to WHO. Researchers developed Pathotypr, an alignment-free tool for tuberculosis genomic surveillance, using 2,145 markers derived from 26,813 genomes. Tested across 88,071 samples, Pathotypr improved classification concordance, expanded uncommon lineage coverage, and detected resistance markers. The open-source tool accepts assembled genomes or raw short reads, returning lineage assignments, WHO-cataloged resistance-associated variants, and a closely related reference genome for downstream analysis. This development supports molecular epidemiology and public health surveillance efforts in tuberculosis control.
